faqs.a: Pick an outfit and tap "Book on WhatsApp". We confirm the fit, dates and total in the chat. You pay the rent and cleaning fee by UPI, plus a refundable deposit, then collect the outfit from us or get it delivered locally at cost.

faqs.q: What if my outfit doesn't fit?
faqs.a: Every listing shows its size, and we send exact measurements on WhatsApp before you pay. You can also try it on when you collect it.
Yes. We check the outfit when you return it and refund the deposit by UPI, usually the same day. We only deduct for real damage, at the repair cost, and show you the before and after videos.
Every piece goes to a professional dry cleaner between rentals. The cleaning fee is shown upfront, before you pay.

faqs.q: What happens if something gets damaged?
faqs.a: Small stains and loose threads are normal wear and are covered by the cleaning fee. We film every outfit at handover and at return, so any real damage is clear to both sides.

faqs.q: How much can I earn as a lender?
faqs.a: You keep 75% of every rental, paid by UPI once the outfit is back and checked. We photograph your pieces, find renters and handle the deposit and cleaning.
